admission.justification: A knowledge diff run against a subdirectory would compare the wrong scope and can report a false clean result.

applicability: knowledge_diff selector handling on a converted memory repository.
conditions: The selector is a path inside the memory repository.
exclusions: A selector outside the memory repository, which the Git route cannot compare.
statement: Knowledge diff refuses a subdirectory supplied as the memory root and names the repository root to use.
